name: Passionate Revelations
source:
Richard and Mary navigate the complexities of marriage in modern times. Richard’s demanding job and postponed vacation leave him stressed, while Mary, feeling neglected, embarks on a solo vacation trip. As Mary’s provocative social media posts ignite Richard’s jealousy and frustration.

[From [url=https://cloaca-games.itch.io/passionate-revelations]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
理查德和玛丽应对现代婚姻的复杂性。理查德的高要求工作和推迟的假期让他压力很大，而玛丽则感到被忽视，开始了一次独自度假旅行。玛丽的挑衅性社交媒体帖子激起了理查德的嫉妒和沮丧。

[来自[url=https://cloaca-games.itch.io/passionate-revelations]Itch.io[/url]]
